entries.note: Handratta 2005 (PMID 15828836) resolves; 93.8% sentence verbatim in abstract. Opener on the LAPC4 track; model_first_use_year 2005 matches the paper.
Purushottamachar 2013 (PMID 23713567) resolves; CWR22rv1 sentence verbatim in abstract. 2013 paper is cell work only; xenograft follow-up is Kwegyir-Afful 2015, correctly named in judgement.
Toren 2015 resolves (epub 2014-10-28, print 2015-01); intratumoral-androgen sentence verbatim in abstract. Year 2014 = epub, consistent with rule 6.

Montgomery 2016 (epub 2015-11-02) resolves; PD sentence verbatim in abstract. Model_src Vasaitis 2008 resolves (AR down-regulation in LAPC4). Downstream PSA read-out, paired; abstract-level as declared.

Maity 2016 (Sci Rep, open access) resolves; DHEA/PSA single-patient sentence verbatim in abstract; the paper itself holds model and patient data, so comparison_stated true is right. n=1, low confidence appropriate.

Peltola (epub 2018-09-05, print 2020) resolves; testosterone sentence verbatim. Oksala model_src resolves (epub 2018-02-10). Castrate patients on prednisone, so proximal read-out is a further fall; direction_only is fair. No untested opener (rule question 5).
Half-life sentence verbatim in Handratta abstract. Untested because no model exposure target; this reading conflicts with dose[5] on the same drug and dose (rule question 1).
Same Purushottamachar quote; opener on the AR-V7 track with no exposure target. Supported.
MR49F sentence verbatim in Toren abstract. Gupta 2018 (PMID 30012563) confirms RP2D 600 mg QD set by tolerability, no DLT through 750 mg. Opener supported.
Peltola abstract verbatim: AUC rose only to 300 mg, fell on day 8, PK prevents development. Sponsor-stated PK failure with no model-stated human target (rule question 1). NCT02344017 has no results.
LAPC4 sentence verbatim in Handratta abstract. Androgen-dependent model; the draft says so. Opener supported.
CWR22rv1 quote verbatim. Opener for the patient-level AR-V7 track; Kwegyir-Afful 2015 full text confirms the AR-V7 depletion claim was tied to the planned phase 3 in AR-V+ patients.
Tumour-growth/PSA sentence verbatim in Toren abstract. Opener supported.

ARMOR2 part 1 PSA50 48% verbatim; NCT01709734 registered primary includes PSA response, so endpoint_role primary holds; no results posted (registry_date null correct). Registry later marks the study terminated for lack of efficacy (see missing); rule 7 keeps the 2015 same.
Oksala VCaP sentence verbatim. Untested follows the PK row of dose[4]; 13% PSA50 (3/23, with prednisone) correctly left as a note. Stands only while dose[4] stays contra.

Taplin 2019 (PMID 31542304) DMC sentence and PSA50 2/16 vs 8/19 verbatim in the PubMed abstract (Europe PMC copy truncated). Contra supported. comparison_stated true doubtful: hypothesis stated, no model data shown (question 3). 2016 vs 2019: question 2.

Madan 2020 (PMID 32327394) quotes verbatim; primary PSA50 at 12 weeks 1/17. Registry record is more likely NCT02130700 (17 enrolled, BID-titration + QD arms, 12-week PSA primary) than NCT02445976 (197, once-daily); neither posted results. Rule question 4.
Opener on the AR-V7 track with the Purushottamachar quote. Handratta 2005 and Vasaitis 2008 abstracts carry no tolerability statement, so the LAPC4 track rightly has no safety entry.
Toren sentence verbatim but it is an AR-axis claim, not a safety statement; the lyase-selectivity/no-steroid claim in the note is inferred. Acceptable as an untested opener.

Montgomery abstract verbatim, and adds 'no apparent mineralocorticoid excess (AME) events'; Kwegyir-Afful 'no apparent host toxicities' verbatim in abstract and full text. same + partial is within the rule; a stricter reader could call the liver-enzyme silence contra.

Bardia 2018 (epub 2018-05-09) DLT sentence verbatim; imported_from MONDO:0007254 correct. Gupta 2018 (prostate, epub 2018-07-16) is an in-indication source the same year: no DLT through 750 mg but dizziness 52%, blurred vision 38%; contra holds either way (rule question 7).

Peltola 'well tolerated up to the highest evaluated dose' and Oksala 'well tolerated in both rodents and primates' both verbatim. Prednisone co-administration limits the mineralocorticoid test, as the draft says.

Madan 'closed prematurely because of the high magnitude of toxicity' verbatim; AEs concentration impairment, fatigue, tremor, nausea. Contra on unstated CNS harm supported; counted once here, consistent with dose[6] moving to untested.

Rafferty 2014 (PMID 24775307, epub 2014-04-16) resolves; sentence verbatim in abstract. Untested opener, class level. Abstract says VT-464 was already in phase 2, so 2014 is the publication date of an older assay; ex_vivo stands in for in-vitro.

Maity 2016 (PMC5066251, epub 2016-10-17) resolves; verbatim in full text. Prospective same holds (patient dosed 2012, assay older). Enzyme numbers are cited from Rafferty (ref 8): strict reading is a pairing, model_src Rafferty 2014. Yin 2017 dispute confirmed.
Rafferty 2014 resolves; MES sentence verbatim in abstract. Untested opener for the adrenal harm the assay speaks to; CNS harms correctly left to the xenograft track.

Maity cortisol sentence verbatim in full text (Supplementary Figure 2). Same holds for the stated harm; n=1, steroid-free 300 mg BID. Same datum as engagement[8] scored on a different question; Madan 2020 steroid-free cohort cited correctly.

Ojala 2020 (PMID 32822743, epub 2020-08-19) resolves; sentence verbatim in abstract. Untested opener sharing the year; model_first_use_year 2020 is publication, modelling preceded Peltola's PK verdict. Abstract-only, paywalled.

Quote verbatim in abstract, which says the tools were evaluated against clinical PK of formulation T1 already in hand (Peltola epub 2018-09-05): retro with retrodiction true is right, never same. T2 prediction never dosed. 'partial' defensible; abstract also reads as match.

Kwegyir-Afful 2015 (PMC4695001, Oncotarget) resolves; sentence verbatim in Discussion, citing Tokai conference reports. Untested opener accepted; whether a retrospective banked-sample subset is instead retro (decision 10) is a rule question. Patient level, ex_vivo CTCs.

Taplin 2019 (PMID 31542304, epub 2019-09-18) resolves; DMC sentence and PSA50 2/16 vs 8/19 verbatim in abstract. Contra, opposite, paired with model_src Kwegyir-Afful (resolves). 2016 tier-5 dating is question 2; assay switch Epic protein to AdnaTest mRNA raised as a rule question.

missing: Tokai 10-K / press release 2016-07-26 (tier 5, SEC filing text at https://ir.eledon.com/static-files/0580574b-a213-4a9b-83f1-dab0fd0e9049): DMC recommendation 2016-07-25 that ARMOR3-SV would likely miss rPFS, no safety concerns cited. The draft cites it in judgement only; under rule 2 it is a dated tier-5 contra entry (trial_unreported true) three years before Taplin 2019.

ARMOR2 AR-V7 subset (Taplin, EORTC-NCI-AACR 2014; news: https://ecancer.org/en/news/6615-galeterone-shows-activity-in-a-variant-form-of-castration-resistant-prostate-cancer): 6/7 AR-V7+ patients had PSA responses on galeterone, the patient-level prospective comparison on the CWR22Rv1 track that preceded ARMOR3-SV; conference-only, no DOI found (rule question 6).

ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01709734 (ARMOR2) status TERMINATED, whyStopped: 'terminated prematurely ... upon recommendation from the DMC. Study was stopped due to lack of efficacy' - a registry datum bearing on the LAPC4-track class-level same; no results posted.

Madan 2020 registry record: NCT02130700 (Innocrin, 17 enrolled, VT-464 BID and QD arms, 12-week PSA change primary, start 2014-04, no results) fits the paper; the draft's inferred NCT02445976 (197 enrolled, once-daily, post-enzalutamide or abiraterone) does not. Full text could not be opened (PMC bot check, Europe PMC 500) to confirm.

Seviteronel class-level patient data outside the post-enzalutamide setting: NCT02012920 and NCT02361086 (phase 1/2 in CRPC, completed, no results posted) and the Shore 2016 ASCO abstract that Bardia 2018 cites as the source of the 750 mg phase 2 dose; not used by the draft.

ODM-204 model dating: NCT02344017 started 2015-02, so the VCaP/monkey model existed by then; no public model source before Oksala (epub 2018-02-10) was found, so model_first_use_year 2018 is a publication date, not first use.

Patient-derived organoids or ex-vivo cells compared with patients for galeterone or seviteronel: none found in one WebSearch; Alyamani 2017 (10.1016/j.chembiol.2017.05.020, resolves) is patient-serum galeterone metabolism explaining the miss, not a model prediction.

ODM-204 cynomolgus-monkey / hCG-rat steroidogenesis and tolerability (Oksala 2019, doi 10.1016/j.jsbmb.2018.02.004, PMID 29438723; abstract confirmed: single oral 10-30 mg/kg dose-dependently inhibited adrenal and testicular steroid production in cynomolgus monkeys, similar in hCG-treated rats, 'well tolerated in both rodents and primates'). Checker (models) agrees with the sweep's split: engagement[6] (Peltola testosterone fall, model_src Oksala) and safety[5] rest on this system, not the VCaP xenograft, so under the one-system-one-model_id rule they belong on their own model_id (e.g. odm204-primate-steroidogenesis) with 2018 untested openers in engagement and safety, leaving odm204-vcap-xenograft with efficacy[5] and dose[4]. Not re-keyed here.

Yin 2017 (doi 10.1124/dmd.117.075317, PMID 28373265; abstract confirmed): side-by-side CYP17A1 enzymatic analysis found seviteronel showed no significant lyase selectivity. A model-side contradiction of the seviteronel-cyp17a1-lyase-selectivity track's own claim with no patient comparison, so no entry; recorded so the track's 'same' is read against a disputed model.
rule_questions: When the model stated no exposure or regimen target, do the derived dose rows ('reached, failed, abandoned' -> contra derived_from efficacy; 'reached, drug worked' -> same) apply at the clinically chosen dose, or does dose stay untested? The draft applies both readings to galeterone's 2,550 mg/d (dose[1] untested, dose[5] contra); if the derived rows apply, the LAPC4 track also needs a 2015 dose same it lacks, and the ODM-204 'PK never reached' contra rests on the sponsor's verdict with no model target.

Dating a failure first public in a press release / SEC filing: ARMOR3-SV futility was public 2016-07-26 (tier 5) but the draft turns the track contra in 2019 on the tier-1 paper because rule 6's date list omits press releases while rule 2 says tier-5 failures must be found. Should the track carry a 2016 tier-5 contra with trial_unreported true, with 2019 as the confirming entry?

comparison_stated for a trial paper that states the model-derived hypothesis in its own words ('galeterone ... induces AR protein degradation. We hypothesized ...') but shows no model data (Taplin 2019): statement or pairing under rule 1?

Toxicity-driven early discontinuation confounding the primary read (Madan 2020: median 2 cycles vs a 12-week PSA50 primary, 1/17): is efficacy contra on the 'reached, failed' row, or untested on the decision-16 toxicity row when no margin was stated? The draft scores contra; the checker moved dose[6] only.

model_first_use_year when the model paper postdates the trial start (ODM-204: trial start 2015-02, model paper 2018-02): open the strip at the registry start as proxy, or at the publication, and is a same-year untested opener required when model and trial papers share the year?

Conference-only patient data with no DOI (ARMOR2 AR-V7 subset, EORTC-NCI-AACR 2014; Shore 2016 ASCO seviteronel phase 1/2): are they admissible at any tier, and if not, how is a prospective patient-level comparison that only exists there recorded?

Imported safety harm when a same-year in-indication source exists (Bardia 2018 breast DLTs vs Gupta 2018 prostate: no DLT through 750 mg, dizziness 52%): which source sets the entry and does the import still need imported_from?

Retrospective biomarker subset (galeterone-ctc-ar-variant-assay efficacy[8]): the Epic Sciences CTC AR C-terminal-loss assay was run on banked ARMOR2 samples and correlated with PSA responses already known (6/7). The draft opens the track untested; decision 10 makes a model run after the clinic knew the answer a retrodiction (retro), but here the subset analysis is itself the first patient read, so it reproduces no prior human result. Opener (untested) or retro?

Assay change between hypothesis and test on one model_id: ARMOR2 used Epic Sciences CTC AR C-terminal-loss protein; ARMOR3-SV selected on the Johns Hopkins AdnaTest CTC AR-V7 mRNA assay. Are these one system (patient CTC AR-variant assays, as drafted) or two? If two, the ARMOR3-SV contra sits on a track with no opener and the Epic assay was never tested prospectively.

comparison_stated when the comparing paper restates the model result from a cited paper: Maity 2016 quotes Rafferty 2014's 10-fold lyase-over-hydroxylase enzyme selectivity (its ref 8) and reads the patient's unchanged cortisol against it; the enzyme data are not Maity's own. Statement (as drafted, engagement[8] and safety[8]) or pairing with model_src Rafferty 2014 under rule 1? Related to question 3.
